The gaze is awake and quietly curious, her own small choice to pay attention, without performing for approval. One brow lifts a fraction; the mouth has a small relaxed asymmetrical closed-lip curve, as if she has noticed an amusing possibility she may or may not explain. She is easy in her own company yet responsive. Not empty or vacant, sleepy by default, infant-cute, a pet begging for attention, cat mouth, giant delighted eyes or a generic hostess smile. Face: softly compact youthful cheek/middle/lower-face relation, natural young cheek volume and a short gently rounded chin. Preserve her own modest eye shape, believable eye/nose/mouth proportions, small subtle nose, fine natural lips and normal restrained eye size. Do not squeeze the whole skull or make the eyes huge to suggest youth. No vertical adult long jaw, pointy glamour chin, long exposed neck, heavy makeup, fashionable lashes, lipstick, 3D glossy skin or round chibi/toddler doll. She remains a recognizable thoughtful young anime girl with her own freedom.

Her short silver-white hair has separated soft locks at cheeks/ears/nape and cool gray-lilac painted shadows, not a shining white helmet. The airy bangs leave both eyes readable. For this near-frontal portrait, HER OWN RIGHT iris is GOLD and HER OWN LEFT iris is BLUE; the viewer sees gold on the left, blue on the right. Do not mirror that identity, turn both irises one color or add a new hair ornament. Both eyes engage the viewer with specific small curiosity, not a blind identical glass highlight. Delicate fine literary 2D hand drawing and softly painted hair/face planes, no photography, plush, plastic, heavy rendering or source-image collage.

Composition: head and hair dominate the square, an intimate near-front view with only a slight natural turn, a little less tilted than the previous portrait. Full crown, identity hair silhouette, both eyes, cheeks and chin safely inside circular-avatar framing. Only a tiny necessary neckline and a hint of white sailor collar with dark navy edging and tan uniform at the bottom, no large torso, hands, arms or shoulders filling half the picture. Soft neutral illumination, subtle natural cheek warmth, clear silver hair and actual gold/blue eyes. No room, scenery, background color, border, avatar circle, logo, text or watermark. Preserve true alpha transparency and fine natural hair edges, never paint a checkerboard.
